lines: I'm the FISHING GURU! I simply Looove fishing!
reward: Take this and fish, young one!
Fishing is a way of life! From the seas to rivers, go out and land the big one, young one!

lines: Hey, kid! What do you think you're doing here? You won't live long in combat!
That's for sure! I tell you kid, electric Pokémon saved me during the war!
battle: They zapped my enemies into paralysis! The same as I'll do to you!
Whoa! You're the real deal, kid! Fine then, take the Thunder Badge!
A little word of advice, kid! Electricity is sure powerful! But, it's useless against ground-type Pokémon!
reward: TM34 contains Shock Wave! Teach it to an Electric Pokémon!

lines: Oh hey! It's been a while. I've snagged two badges since we first met.
battle: You too huh? I thought so! Let's put each other to the test.
You're seriously just a step ahead of me. It's admirable, really.
The Lucky Egg speeds up training significantly. I hope you put it to good use. Well, it's back to training for me.
reward: I've got another useful item for you, my friend.
